contract_note: Only profiles marked implemented/selectable may be accepted by config validation. Existing local/GitFS paths are legacy baselines, not the target or a new-deployment recommendation. Target profiles from docs/design/12-state-services.md are rejected until runtime acceptance gates pass.

profiles.scope: existing production baseline; default GitFS backend, labelled legacy and not the target architecture

authority.refs: persistent bare Git repository under ROOTYARD_DATA_DIR (GitFS); native receive-pack writes the authoritative bare path, guarded by PG admission/fence
authority.content: local data volume (legacy); LFS may use the remote-object adapter when configured
authority.cache_wake: in-process bounded cache/wake; optional Kafka/Redis-loopback adapters are not correctness authorities
authority.events: PG outbox + GitFS operation journal + reconciliation
authority.artifact_registry: PG/storage lifecycle for the existing GitFS backend

limitations: legacy runtime, not the target state-services architecture
persistent bare Git is the refs authority; target profiles must not select it
Git filesystem and PG do not share an atomic commit
single data volume / single process authority; no multi-host production claim

profiles.scope: existing optional Pando gateway path, selected per repository by repositories.storage_backend='pando'; requires a real remote object store and Vault for encrypted content

authority.content: encrypted pack/idx/manifests via PackStore RemoteObjectStore plus VaultTransit-wrapped data keys; plaintext local staging is a disposable cache, not the durable pack authority
authority.cache_wake: existing service cache/wake; not a RefStore decision authority
authority.events: PG publication transaction + existing outbox/reliability paths
authority.artifact_registry: PG pando remote artifact/fence lease ledger; baseline DELETE behavior is governed by ROOTYARD_PANDO_REMOTE_DELETE and a default-deny hardening is pending PR #92, not claimed at this baseline

limitations: PG state row remains the publication hotspot
local plaintext pack files are a disposable cache; content durability requires the remote provider and Vault key availability
remote physical DELETE can be explicitly enabled by env at baseline; default-deny is pending PR #92 and must not be attributed to this baseline
does not provide the proposed stable CommitRefs/GetOperation/cancel contract

profiles.scope: existing storage/remote_objects.rs S3 adapter used by Pando/LFS/mirror/lab paths; not a service-wide OpenDAL Blob authority

authority.content: remote object adapter with Local fallback when ROOTYARD_OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT is absent

profiles.reject_reason: Not selectable as a deployment profile: no OpenDAL Operator, no unified durable receipt or capability gate, and it silently falls back to Local. Enabling it would misrepresent the target Blob contract.
limitations: hand-written S3 request path rather than a reusable provider abstraction
used only by limited Pando/LFS/mirror/lab paths

profiles.scope: target design: one Rootyard process + PostgreSQL + OpenDAL Blob, memory cache/wake, built-in workers

authority.events: PG + built-in workers; Git events from RefStore projection

profiles.reject_reason: No PgRefStore, BlobStore, OpenDAL dependency, decision bridge, hold bridge or standalone wiring exists at d689bf8. Selecting this profile must fail config validation.
required_before_enable: clear computation cache/session/temp directory recovery with PG+Blob only

profiles.scope: target design: PG business metadata + Raft Ref-CAS + Redis cache/wake + same OpenDAL Blob

authority.content: same OpenDalBlobStore provider class as standalone
authority.events: RefStore commit events projected to PG + PG business outbox

profiles.reject_reason: No RaftRefStore, Ref-CAS service, remote Redis client, decision bridge, hold bridge or distributed acceptance exists at d689bf8. Selecting this profile must fail config validation.
required_before_enable: W5 Ref-CAS service with durable quorum and ReadIndex
W3/W4 bridge and hold protocol acceptance
V26 single-to-multi consistency and V09/V10/V11 distributed fault tests

profiles.scope: separate pando-lab feature/binary and schema; not the main service deployment
profiles.reject_reason: Experimental binary/schema; cannot be selected as the main service deployment profile.

immutable_locator.note: A reused attempt UUID or a non-positive generation invalidates the locator.

remote_gc_gate.baseline: Remote physical delete is governed by the existing retention ledger and ROOTYARD_PANDO_REMOTE_DELETE; default-deny hardening is pending PR #92.
remote_gc_gate.target: No destructive GC for a new RefStore/Blob authority until issues #113/#114 and the W4 hold/root bridge acceptance pass.
remote_gc_gate.forbidden: Treating LIST absence, ETag, a lease expiry, or a lagging PG projection as proof that bytes are unreferenced.

auth_compatibility.retained: src/auth.rs finish_tx re-checks live token validity/expiry in the mutation transaction at commit time.
auth_compatibility.future_gate: The RefStore admission-time expiry contract may not silently weaken or replace finish_tx commit-time validity; a compatibility gate from design section 9.5 must be accepted explicitly.

reject_rules.reason: Profile is not implemented/selectable at the W0 baseline.
legacy-gitfs-postgres must use gitfs-bare refs and the GitFS data volume, without remote Blob/KMS profile wiring.
pando-postgres-pack-store requires PG Pando refs plus a real remote object store and Vault; local pack files are only a disposable cache.
Memory/fs Blob drivers are forbidden for production; they are test-isolation only.
PG/Raft WAL and vote/term state must use their database/embedded-store durability contract, not Blob objects.
Persistent bare Git is allowed only for the legacy runtime/import path, never as a target state-services authority.

permitted_legacy_import_exception.allowed: Explicit legacy GitFS import/source-read path and the existing legacy-gitfs-postgres runtime profile.
permitted_legacy_import_exception.not_allowed: New target profiles, new repositories, or fallback writes that create a persistent bare Git authority.
permitted_legacy_import_exception.note: The experiment imports from GitFS into Pando; the target design additionally forbids persistent bare Git after import.
